results.name: fleet
results.reason: Learn lists 2026-06-01 as the latest stable GA; 2026-06-02-preview is newer but preview. The exact stable Fleet schema requires location, accepts tags as string-valued properties, and accepts SystemAssigned identity. The fleetName route parameter requires 1–63 lowercase alphanumeric/hyphen characters; the source default fleet-aks-chaos-lab-dev satisfies it. Caller overrides to appName/environment are unconstrained and must still satisfy that route constraint.
results.migration: Current 2026-06-01 is latest GA; no GA migration needed.

usage.label: name
usage.analysis: body:8: Bicep source JSON Pointer /name (expression 'name: fleetName'); Bicep resource name is the fleetName URL path parameter, not a request-body field (Fleet.name is read-only). The exact PUT path parameter requires 1–63 characters and ^[a-z0-9]([-a-z0-9]*[a-z0-9])?$. main.bicep constructs fleet-aks-chaos-lab-dev from defaults (23 characters; pattern valid). appName/environment overrides have no local constraints, so overrides must preserve this API constraint.

usage.label: location
usage.analysis: body:30: Bicep source JSON Pointer /location (expression 'location: location'); Maps to required TrackedResource.location (string). The module receives main.bicep's default japaneast, which is a string; the REST schema defines no location enum/pattern constraint.

usage.label: tags
usage.analysis: body:47: Bicep source JSON Pointer /tags (expression 'tags: tags'); Maps to optional TrackedResource.tags object; additionalProperties must be strings. main.bicep supplies {'azd-env-name': environment}, whose value is a string parameter.

usage.label: identity
usage.analysis: body:64: Bicep source JSON Pointer /identity (expression 'identity: {'); Maps to optional Fleet.identity ManagedServiceIdentity; the supplied object contains the required type field.

usage.label: type
usage.analysis: body:76: Bicep source JSON Pointer /identity/type (expression "type: 'SystemAssigned'"); Maps to required ManagedServiceIdentity.type; 'SystemAssigned' is an exact allowed enum value.

current.analysis: Learn selector, pinned REST README and exact stable fleets.json identify the current contract. Schemas helper resolved Fleet allOf with common Resource/TrackedResource, the identity v4 definition, and the required location, tags additionalProperties:string, and identity.type enum. The exact PUT operation confirms fleetName path bounds/pattern. Current default values satisfy them; caller override caveat is recorded in the per-usage analysis.

ga.analysis: Learn lists 2026-06-01 as the newest stable GA and a newer 2026-06-02-preview. The pinned REST README maps package-2026-06-01 to stable/2026-06-01/fleets.json and the preview tag to preview/2026-06-02-preview/fleets.json; the exact candidate stable schema is the current schema. The preview body was fetched but is not treated as a GA candidate.
